summary: Pull requests now skip the typescript-client check when a trusted signed note already covers the tree (one run in five still runs it to compare); the merge queue keeps running it, through a new per-check events limit in the skip policy

replay.detail: No graph, claim or storage change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule change. The skip policy gains an optional per-check events list; typescript-client is enforced for pull_request only.

compatibility.detail: Required check names and results are unchanged: a skipped typescript-client job still ends in success with the step 'evidence covered by a trusted note'. Merge-group runs are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Set enforce back to false for typescript-client in .st/evidence-skip-policy.json (the policy is read from the base, so it takes effect for runs after the revert merges).
